title: Application of New England Power Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 14, for authorization and approval of one or more additional issues of General and Refunding Mortgage Bonds; one or more additional issues of First Mortgage Bonds; execution of one or more loan agreements or supplemental loan agreements in connection with refinancing outstanding Pollution Control Revenue Bonds; execution of one or more Interest Rate Swap Agreements; and an exemption from the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 15.
